evidence: The Cu2S films were grown by ALD in a traveling wave type 4 -inch chamber (Atomic-Class, CN-1) using Cu(dmamb)2 (UP chemical, Korea) and a gas mixture of 95% N2 and 5% H2S. The flow rate of H2S and Ar purge gases were 300 and 1000 sccm, respectively. The Cu precursor contained in a stainless steel bubbler type canister was heated at 60 oC and was delivered into the reaction chamber with the aid of ultrapure Ar gas at a flow rate of 50 sccm.
